Introduction to FBR E-Invoice Integration Deadline Extension

What is FBR e-invoice integration deadline extension? The Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) has extended the deadline for e-invoice integration for sales tax registrants in Pakistan. This extension is aimed at facilitating businesses in complying with the new invoicing system.

Key Takeaway: FBR extends e-invoice integration deadline.

The FBR has introduced the e-invoicing system to reduce tax evasion and increase transparency in business transactions. The system requires businesses to generate electronic invoices for all sales transactions and integrate them with the FBR's IRIS portal.

Core Explanation of E-Invoice Integration

To integrate e-invoices with the FBR's IRIS portal, businesses need to obtain a Sales Tax Registration Number (STRN) and a Tier-1 retailer status. They also need to install a Point of Sale (POS) terminal and generate a QR invoice for each sales transaction.

Key Takeaway: E-invoice integration requires STRN and Tier-1 retailer status.

The FBR has specified the technical requirements for e-invoice integration, including API protocols and data formats. Businesses can use third-party software or develop their own in-house solution to integrate with the FBR's IRIS portal.

Step-by-Step Guide to E-Invoice Integration

Here are the steps to integrate e-invoices with the FBR's IRIS portal:

  1. Obtain a Sales Tax Registration Number (STRN) from the FBR.
  2. Apply for Tier-1 retailer status.
  3. Install a Point of Sale (POS) terminal.
  4. Generate a QR invoice for each sales transaction.
  5. Integrate the POS terminal with the FBR's IRIS portal using API protocols.
  6. Test the integration to ensure that it is working correctly.
  7. Train staff on the new invoicing system.

Key Takeaway: E-invoice integration requires a 7-step process.

Common Mistakes in E-Invoice Integration

Here are some common mistakes that businesses make when integrating e-invoices with the FBR's IRIS portal:

  • Failure to obtain a Sales Tax Registration Number (STRN)
  • Failure to apply for Tier-1 retailer status
  • Failure to install a Point of Sale (POS) terminal
  • Failure to generate a QR invoice for each sales transaction
  • Failure to integrate the POS terminal with the FBR's IRIS portal

Key Takeaway: Common mistakes can result in penalties.

The FBR has specified penalties for non-compliance with the e-invoicing system, including a fine of PKR 10,000 for each day of non-compliance.

Deeper Insight into E-Invoice Integration

The FBR's IRIS portal uses API protocols to integrate with businesses' POS terminals. The API protocols require businesses to send invoices in a specific data format, including the invoice number, date, and amount.

Key Takeaway: API protocols require specific data formats.

Benefits of E-Invoice Integration

The benefits of e-invoice integration include:

  • Reduced tax evasion
  • Increased transparency in business transactions
  • Improved efficiency in invoicing and payment processing
  • Reduced errors in invoicing and payment processing
  • Improved customer satisfaction

Key Takeaway: E-invoice integration has several benefits.
